City id berlin is unused in uk-architecture.md, scoped-cities-2026-08-28.md, and existing packs (rotterdam, goteborg, malmo, uppsala, washington, …). Display Berlin. Agency BVG, not S-Bahn Berlin GmbH, not DB, not VBB as a city. Do not invent city=germany or city=brandenburg.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: TRAIN-like = BVG U-Bahn U1–U9 only. No S-Bahn, no DB / RE / RB / FEX, no tram, no bus, no ferry, no BVG Muva, no U10, no passenger U55, no construction-closed U6 north of Kurt-Schumacher-Platz.
Timezone Europe/Berlin HAS DST (CEST/CET). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.

Nine printed U-Bahn lines on the official BVG index: U1 Warschauer Str.–Uhlandstr.; U2 Pankow–Ruhleben; U3 Warschauer Str.–Krumme Lanke; U4 Nollendorfplatz–Innsbrucker Platz; U5 Hönow–Hauptbahnhof (includes former U55); U6 Kurt-Schumacher-Platz–Alt-Mariendorf (map still prints closed Alt-Tegel); U7 Rathaus Spandau–Rudow; U8 Wittenau–Hermannstr.; U9 Osloer Str.–Rathaus Steglitz.

Locked inner-city printed name: Alexanderplatz (Innenstadtausschnitt Mitte node; BVG halte title S+U Alexanderplatz; U2/U5/U8 cross). Not Berlin, not Mitte, not City, not Hauptbahnhof (U5-only U-Bahn), not Nollendorfplatz (U-Bahn-only 4-line Kleinprofil node — shared approach). doNotGroup U vs S vs Regional at Alexanderplatz.

170 unique passenger-open U-Bahn stop strings. 203 line ticks. 25 shared U-Bahn interchanges. Four map-printed U6 north stations (Otisstr., Holzhauser Str., Borsigwerke, Alt-Tegel) are closed and not inserted. Dual-name S+U ticks use the BVG U-Bahn halt-list string without the U / S+U prefix (Warschauer Str., not S Warschauer Straße).

Map vs halt list: BVG line pages prefix U / S+U; D1 locks the name without that prefix and keeps official abbreviations (Str., ß in Schloßstr.) and official parentheticals (Freie Universität (Thielplatz), Kienberg (Gärten der Welt), Magdalenenstr. (Campus für Demokratie), Kochstr./Checkpoint Charlie). Anton-Wilhelm-Amo-Str. not Mohrenstraße (23 Aug 2025).
